title.zh: 【币安将调整巴西用户加密资产像境外转移充提流程，11 月 1 日起生效】
title.en: 【币安将调整巴西用户加密资产像境外转移充提流程，11 月 1 日起生效】

current_state.zh: Binance will tighten cross-border crypto deposit and withdrawal procedures for Brazilian users from November 1, 2026 to comply with Brazilian central bank Resolution 521/2025, requiring transfer-purpose and counterparty identification, monthly reporting to the BCB, and a USD 100,000 per-transaction cap for transfers with unlicensed foreign counterparties.
current_state.en: Binance will tighten cross-border crypto deposit and withdrawal procedures for Brazilian users from November 1, 2026 to comply with Brazilian central bank Resolution 521/2025, requiring transfer-purpose and counterparty identification, monthly reporting to the BCB, and a USD 100,000 per-transaction cap for transfers with unlicensed foreign counterparties.
